import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.util.StringTokenizer

private const val MAXN = 500

fun modPow(a: Long, e: Long, mod: Long): Long {
    var base = (a % mod + mod) % mod
    var exp = e
    var res = 1L
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp and 1L == 1L) res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp = exp shr 1
    }
    return res
}

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val st = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    val n = st.nextToken().toInt()
    val m = st.nextToken().toInt()
    val p = st.nextToken().toLong()

    val fact = LongArray(n + 1)
    val invFact = LongArray(n + 1)
    fact[0] = 1L
    for (i in 1..n) fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p
    invFact[n] = modPow(fact[n], p - 2, p)
    for (i in n downTo 1) invFact[i - 1] = invFact[i] * i % p

    fun comb(nn: Int, kk: Int): Long {
        if (kk < 0 || kk > nn) return 0L
        return (((fact[nn] * invFact[kk]) % p) * invFact[nn - kk]) % p
    }

    val pow2 = LongArray(m + 1)
    pow2[0] = 1L
    for (i in 1..m) pow2[i] = (pow2[i - 1] * 2L) % p

    val dp = Array(n + 1) { LongArray(m + 1) }
    dp[0][0] = 1L
    for (i in 1..n) {
        dp[i][0] = 1L
        for (k in 1..m) {
            dp[i][k] = (dp[i - 1][k] + dp[i - 1][k - 1] * 2L) % p
        }
    }

    var answer = 0L
    for (i in 1..n) {
        for (j in i + 1..n) {
            val d = (j - i).toLong()
            val left = i - 1
            val right = n - j
            val inside = j - i - 1
            for (k in 1..m) {
                if (k > n) break
                val waysInside = dp[inside][k - 1]
                if (waysInside == 0L) continue
                val remaining = m - k
                var sumSides = 0L
                for (l in 0..remaining) {
                    val r = remaining - l
                    if (l > left || r > right) continue
                    val waysL = comb(left, l)
                    val waysR = comb(right, r)
                    val waysDir = pow2[l + r]
                    val add = (((waysL * waysR) % p) * waysDir) % p
                    sumSides = (sumSides + add) % p
                }
                val contrib = (((waysInside * sumSides) % p) * d) % p
                answer = (answer + contrib) % p
            }
        }
    }

    println(answer % p)
}

import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.util.StringTokenizer

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val st = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    val n = st.nextToken().toInt()
    val m = st.nextToken().toInt()
    val p = st.nextToken().toLong()

    val fact = LongArray(n + 1)
    val invFact = LongArray(n + 1)

    fun modPow(a: Long, e: Long): Long {
        var base = (a % p + p) % p
        var exp = e
        var res = 1L
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp and 1L == 1L) res = (res * base) % p
            base = (base * base) % p
            exp = exp shr 1
        }
        return res
    }

    fact[0] = 1L
    for (i in 1..n) fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p
    invFact[n] = modPow(fact[n], p - 2)
    for (i in n downTo 1) invFact[i - 1] = invFact[i] * i % p

    fun comb(nn: Int, kk: Int): Long {
        if (kk < 0 || kk > nn) return 0L
        return (((fact[nn] * invFact[kk]) % p) * invFact[nn - kk]) % p
    }

    val C = Array(n + 1) { LongArray(n + 1) }
    for (i in 0..n) {
        for (j in 0..i) {
            C[i][j] = comb(i, j)
        }
    }

    val pow2 = LongArray(m + 1)
    pow2[0] = 1L
    for (i in 1..m) pow2[i] = (pow2[i - 1] * 2L) % p

    val dp = Array(n + 1) { LongArray(m + 1) }
    val ways = Array(n + 1) { LongArray(m + 1) }

    ways[0][0] = 1L

    for (len in 1..n) {
        for (k in 0..m) {
            var w = 0L
            var s = 0L
            for (t in 0..k) {
                val left = t
                val right = k - t
                if (left > len || right > len) continue
                val chooseLeft = C[len][left]
                val chooseRight = C[len][right]
                val waysHere = chooseLeft * chooseRight % p
                if (waysHere == 0L) continue
                val prevWays = ways[len - 1][k - t]
                if (prevWays == 0L) continue
                val totalWays = waysHere * prevWays % p
                w = (w + totalWays) % p

                val prevSum = dp[len - 1][k - t]
                val addMadness = (t.toLong() * (len - t).toLong()) % p
                val curMadness = (prevSum + addMadness * prevWays) % p
                s = (s + chooseLeft * chooseRight % p * curMadness) % p
            }
            ways[len][k] = w
            dp[len][k] = s
        }
    }

    var ans = 0L
    for (len in m..n) {
        val remaining = n - len
        val waysAssign = C[n][len]
        val waysDir = pow2[m]
        val totalWays = ways[len][m] * waysAssign % p * waysDir % p
        val totalMadness = dp[len][m] * waysAssign % p * waysDir % p
        ans = (ans + totalMadness) % p
    }

    println(ans % p)
}

import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader

private const val MAXN = 500

fun main() {
    val br = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val st = StringTokenizer(br.readLine())
    val n = st.nextToken().toInt()
    val m = st.nextToken().toInt()
    val p = st.nextToken().toLong()

    val fact = LongArray(n + 1)
    val invFact = LongArray(n + 1)
    fact[0] = 1L
    for (i in 1..n) fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p
    fun modPow(a: Long, e: Long): Long {
        var base = a % p
        var exp = e
        var res = 1L
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp and 1L) != 0L) res = res * base % p
            base = base * base % p
            exp = exp shr 1
        }
        return res
    }
    invFact[n] = modPow(fact[n], p - 2)
    for (i in n downTo 1) invFact[i - 1] = invFact[i] * i % p
    fun comb(nn: Int, kk: Int): Long {
        if (kk < 0 || kk > nn) return 0L
        return fact[nn] * invFact[kk] % p * invFact[nn - kk] % p
    }

    val dp = Array(n + 1) { LongArray(m + 1) }
    val sumDp = Array(n + 1) { LongArray(m + 1) }
    dp[0][0] = 1L

    for (len in 1..n) {
        for (k in 1..minOf(len, m)) {
            var ways = 0L
            var sumMad = 0L
            for (pos in 1..len) {
                val left = pos - 1
                val right = len - pos
                val maxL = minOf(left, k - 1)
                for (l in 0..maxL) {
                    val r = k - 1 - l
                    if (r < 0 || r > right) continue
                    val waysLeft = dp[left][l]
                    val waysRight = dp[right][r]
                    if (waysLeft == 0L || waysRight == 0L) continue
                    val waysHere = waysLeft * waysRight % p
                    val addWays = waysHere * 2L % p
                    ways = (ways + addWays) % p

                    val sumLeft = sumDp[left][l]
                    val sumRight = sumDp[right][r]
                    val baseSum = (sumLeft * waysRight + sumRight * waysLeft) % p
                    val baseSum2 = baseSum * 2L % p

                    val cntLeft = l.toLong()
                    val cntRight = r.toLong()
                    val madHere = ((cntLeft + cntRight) % p) * waysHere % p
                    val madHere2 = madHere * 2L % p

                    sumMad = (sumMad + baseSum2 + madHere2) % p
                }
            }
            dp[len][k] = ways
            sumDp[len][k] = sumMad
        }
    }

    val ans = sumDp[n][m] % p
    println(ans)

The $$$i$$$-th of them enters the contest room in the direction $$$b_i$$$ and goes to sit behind the $$$a_i$$$-th computer.
